item.title: Replace string order statuses with OrderStatus
item.brief:
Refactor the orders crate to use a proper typed order status, preserving observable behavior exactly.

Requirements:
- Add src/status.rs defining public enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }, deriving at least Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash.
- Implement OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str returning "pending", "paid", "shipped", "cancelled" respectively. Implement Display with the same output.
- Implement FromStr for OrderStatus with type Err = ParseStatusError. Make ParseStatusError public, implement std::error::Error, and ensure its message names the rejected input.
- Implement OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool with exactly these allowed transitions: Pending -> Paid, Pending -> Cancelled, Paid -> Shipped, Paid -> Cancelled. All others false.
- Change Order::status to OrderStatus, re-export OrderStatus and ParseStatusError at the crate root, and use OrderStatus throughout the crate. Status string literals must occur only in src/status.rs.
- Preserve observable behavior (including errors, report output and ordering, and parsing) exactly.
- Run cargo test and ensure it passes.
- Commit the work on the item branch; do not push.

Acceptance: implementation meets every API and transition requirement; no status name literals outside src/status.rs; cargo test passes; a commit contains the change.
